reconstruction.scope: Specific Baidicheng core: eight named mapped hall/temple footprints articulated into gray swept tile roof ranges, open main/eastern courts, a taller White House, northern U/L exhibition ranges and an ochre/red decorated Baidi gateway with a real rounded arch, triple roof crests, original simplified painted-panel/scroll vocabulary, stairs and two simplified stone guardians. Island landform, trees, shoreline, bridge, external paths and independent buildings remain host context. No complete ancient fortress restoration, copied text/narrative painting or museum interior.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: Retain original standard6m Mapzen hill terrain and water. Each hall/roof section has a separate local level floor with grade-buried base edges. Main/eastern courts and central garden remain open native ground, without a broad flattened island platform or ground/water cutout. Short gateway stairs/threshold connect to sampled local grade. Wooded coarse DEM does not resolve individual terrace levels, paving, covered passages, shoreline reservoir elevations or thresholds.
